reading.action: Withhold fire (the creature IS fire). Wait for it to near the narrow, strike as hard as able with COLD REVENGE (cold pole vs furnace), and SIMULTANEOUSLY will-pull heat-essence directly from the struck spot INTO himself (live drain from an active dense source).

partA_strike.note: situational +2 = cold pole vs ember-core. Low margin -> shallow hit, shell turns it.

partB_drain.note: affinityBias +2 = Ember Manipulation. Solid margin -> real pull + contained (minor overflow self-burn), through a poorly-opened spot so limited, not the deep core-surge a clean strike would've given.

reading.result: STRIKE (margin 5, weak): Cold Revenge's cold pole bites with a hiss of cold-on-hot and a shallow spall of slag, but the stone-slag SHELL turns most of his MIGHT — he jars/marks it, does NOT wound it deeply, and learns how tough the shell is. Poor opening for the drain. DRAIN (margin 12, solid): his WILL reaches PAST the shell into the heat itself and pulls a real draught of ember-essence up the contact into himself; the struck crack GUTTERS DIM as its core-heat bleeds out. Because the strike was shallow he gets a meaningful but LIMITED pull (not the deep core-surge). Pulling furnace-heat into a body that 'only holds so much from fire' scorches him at the edges — minor overflow self-burn — but he CONTAINS it. KEY DISCOVERY (perceived): the drain reached what the bar could not — its core is both its weakness and its fuel; brute strikes turn on the shell, the siphon bypasses it. ABSORPTION EVENT (his first drain from an ACTIVE source) -> Ember Manipulation 3 -> 4 (within-tier, +1). SKILL EMERGED: 'Ember Siphon' (Novice 1) — drawing ember/heat essence out of a source through a contact point into himself. COST: HP 80->74 (-6 overflow scorch), Focus 110->96 (-14 willed drain), Stamina 54->51 (-3 hard swing). He is now brim-full of borrowed heat (narrative; not mechanized). CREATURE: marked + dimmed at the spot, NOT badly hurt, still very much up — now roused, turning its slow bulk to retaliate. STOP at his decision point — its retaliation has NOT landed (it's slow; he earned the initiative window). NO assumed next move. NO Tower reset.
